items.title: Eleven properties of a morphism of algebraic spaces are insensitive to a finite order thickening
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The spaces-side form of the thickening-transfer lemma: for a morphism of thickenings of algebraic spaces over S with X = Y x_{Y'} X' and X in X' a finite order thickening, eleven properties transfer between f and f'. The proof chooses surjective etale charts to pass down to the schemes case for most items, then handles the differential criterion and the immersion and finiteness cases directly, using the identification of the sheaf of differentials and the structure of finite order thickenings. Reducing a spaces-side statement to a scheme-side one through charts is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2066-2146.
